scope: New isolated Nollagam pinned-source consumer only; runtime integration remains for root

verification.sourceLoader: Real source bytes with stub fetch only; no network requests

contract.loaderSource: /data/nollagam-commercial.json; SHA256 of exact response bytes verified before parsing/normalization
contract.loaderFailure: Every one of the7 scoped slugs receives status unavailable, record null and date null; no fallback from a bound failure
contract.scopeRecognition: isNollagamQuoteProject(project) recognizes the seven known slugs; wrong developer/identity fails a bound context
contract.contextGuard: nollagamOwnerQuoteContext(project) accepts only original ready-context objects created by the pinned loader, matching all identity allowlist fields
contract.matcher: matchNollagamOwnerQuotes(project,state) returns null for other projects/modes, inactive price or no own context property
contract.legacyWithoutOwnContext: Explicit root-authorized delegation to previous pipeline; raw callers remain unchanged
contract.boundContextFailure: Own null/undefined/unavailable/forged/copied/crossed context returns a non-null match with matches false for active price
contract.query: Preserve every queryFromCatalogState predicate; existing metro provenance helper also applies; purchase modes lacking source evidence and unsupported unit/model/stock/availability selectors fail
contract.witness: nollagamOwnerQuoteWitness(match) selects the minimum positive price only among matching references belonging to the bound record
contract.offer: nollagamOwnerQuoteOffer(match) -> value,typology,referenceId,date,financialBaselineCompatible:false; null for a delegated match
contract.facts: nollagamOwnerQuoteFacts(match) -> only matching Tipologías, or empty array
contract.note: nollagamOwnerQuoteNote(match) -> original owner date, typology scope and no-unit/no-stock notice

limits: No current public or local application loader has been connected by this subtask.
The original catalogue false negative remains open until root binds the seven contexts and connects the helpers.
18 normalizer tests and14 consumer tests are separate delta suites, not global131 certification.
Unknown property/use and all other non-price/D option facts remain excluded while active; original dates do not certify stock or price validity.
